label: PF Backlog 206
title: Backend: adopt A2A - expose/consume agents over Agent2Agent for cross-system interop
body:
## Problem / why
A2A is the agent<->agent interop standard; without it we cannot collaborate with external agent systems.
## Goal
Expose our agents over A2A and consume remote A2A agents (discovery, delegate, share results).
## Acceptance criteria
- A remote A2A agent can be invoked; our agent can be invoked by an A2A client.
## Verification
- Two-process A2A round-trip; delegate a subtask and receive results.
